description: BlueSky: read a post and its thread (parents + replies) as compact JSON. Accepts an AT-URI or a bsky.app post URL. Each post includes uri+cid (needed to reply/like/repost).

sessionId.description: Browser session ID. If omitted, auto-selects the only open session.

tabId.description: Target a specific tab within the session (the bsky.app tab). Auto-resolved if omitted.

uri.description: Post AT-URI (at://...) OR a bsky.app post URL (https://bsky.app/profile/<handle>/post/<rkey>).

name: bluesky_thread
